newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed prices recover after losses.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed prices recover after losses.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Thursday showed gains after recent losses, rising to 1,148/1,149 rupees per quintal from 1,142/1,143 rupees on fresh buying, dealers said.
"Export interest for castoroil prompted short-covering by bears which dragged prices up," a dealer said.
Volumes however remained slow as major operators kept to the sidelines eyeing the progress of monsoon.
Groundnut oil remained steady at 355/357 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals while physical demand remained at a low ebb. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 555/560 rupees per 15 kg.
In Bombay, imported palm oil rose by 1/2 rupees at 267/268 rupees per 10 kg on the back of recovery in the world market, one broker said.
But dealers said rising prices may not last long in view of increasing arrivals -- about 2,500 tonnes of imported palm oil reported at the Bombay port and a further 4,000/5,000 tonnes expected.
